normalized_matching_profile.description: HIGHLIGHTS:- Private beach access- Complimentary beach set up each morning include 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- 4-day access to your choice of a paddle board or other equivalent items, one per day. - Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Luxury rated by Andrew Harper- Large Gulf-front porch and patio- Gas grill- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Savor the "Endless View" when you book your stay at 74 Majestica Circle! This beautiful Seagrove home features 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and everything you need to wonderfully accommodate 20 guests - including a private heated pool, a carriage house, and an outdoor dining area overlooking the beautiful sugar-white sand beach! A gorgeous private courtyard and sparkling private pool welcome guests to this beautiful oceanside retreat. Inside, 2 spacious levels and elegant coastal decor set the scene for a tranquil and memorable getaway.The second floor offers an open floor plan for the main living areas, which are surrounded by windows to frame the breathtaking Emerald Coast views. In the spacious kitchen, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a premium gas range give you everything you need to enjoy preparing meals for your group, which can be enjoyed at the dining table or on the balcony overlooking the ombre blue waves. The living and sitting areas are beautifully furnished and offer the perfect place to sink down after a lovely meal. On this level is a stunning primary suite, boasting a lavish king bed, balcony access, sweeping ocean views, and a private bathroom with a shower and a tub.Guests can choose from a variety of sleeping accommodations down on the first floor. The first guest room features 2 luxurious queen beds and access to a shared bathroom with a shower. The remaining two bedrooms on this level are a king bed guest room and a spacious bunk room with 2 sets of built-in queen-over-queen bunk beds plus two trundles. These 2 bedrooms are connected by a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a shower. This level also offers a cozy secondary living room and a sunroom. For those seeking a little more privacy, the carriage house is the perfect space. This area features a full kitchen, a living room, a bunk room with a built-in twin-over-twin bunk bed, a queen bed guest room, and a shared bathroom with a shower.This home features complimentary beach setup of 4 chairs and 2 umbrellas daily and a private beach walkover to the sugar-white sand. Guests in this home can utilize the 5 custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes to explore the local gems along Highway 30A. Now's the time to plan your next 30A getaway. This incredible Seagrove home is ready and waiting to show you the "Endless View" you've been dreaming of. Reserve your stay today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with ShowerGuest Bedroom: 2 Queen Over Queen Bunk Beds, 2 Twin Trundle Beds, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with ShowerGuest Bedroom: 1 King Bed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: 1 King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerCARRIAGE HOUSE:Bunk room: 1 Built-In Twin over Twin Bunk, Shared Bathroom with ShowerGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with ShowerWeddings and Events are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
